normalize_gtest_json_output: normalize a Google Test JSON output object by replacing transient time, timestamp, and stack trace values with wildcards
normalize_time_fields: normalize time fields in a Google Test JSON object by replacing duration strings with asterisks
normalize_timestamp_fields: normalize timestamp fields in a Google Test JSON object by replacing ISO timestamp strings with asterisks
normalize_failure_messages: normalize failure messages in a Google Test JSON object by replacing file paths and stack traces with wildcards
normalize_nested_json: recursively normalize a nested dict or list of Google Test JSON output objects
